edge_cases: edge replication at i=0 and i=n-1 (clamp-to-edge, NOT zero-padding)
asymmetric weights (2,5,3) so tap-order bugs are detectable
halo bytes at tile boundaries come from the actual neighboring tile's data via a DMA'd 1-byte halo on each side of the VTCM buffer, not garbage/zero
first tile has no left neighbor: DMA CH+1 bytes and replicate the left halo byte after the DMA completes
tail n not a multiple of the DMA chunk size (1200000 % 16384 = 3968)

n=1,200,000 (not the originally-specified 300,000): int8 dtype needs 4x the element count of the int32 tasks to clear the ~1MB L2 threshold the DMA/VTCM mechanism needs to show any speedup -- at n=300,000 (300KB, under L2) the expert was measured SLOWER than baseline (0.585x); corrected per AUTHORING_GUIDE.md Sec.3
